articles.title: Meghan Markle “distressed” after learning of “sickening” allegations against her father | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 梅根·马克尔（ Meghan Markle ）在得知对她父亲的“令人作呕”的指控后“心烦意乱” |
articles.summary:
Meghan Markle says she was informed about "disturbing allegations" about her estranged father Thomas Markle in 2018. He is being investigated by the authorities in the Philippines over allegations relating to images of child abuse. 

In a statement, Meghan said a letter containing allegations against Thomas Markle was sent to the UK police that year and subsequently shared with her.  She described the allegations as "more sickening than one could ever imagine" and said her "sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children".

Her comments come after reports that images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to her father had been found at his former home in the Philippines.  Thomas Markle, who is 82 and based in the US, denies possessing any such images and describes the claims as “sick lies”. 

Meghan Markle said: "I am deeply distressed at the news that has come to light in the last 24 hours, and my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed."

She said that when she received the letter outlining allegations against her father, she was "given assurance that these were being investigated". She added she hoped it could be understood why she had kept her distance from her father and did "not allow him to have contact with our children".  

This was "to protect them", Meghan said, adding that she had "trusted that the authorities were doing the same for other families".

Meghan's half-brother, Thomas Markle junior, told the Sun newspaper that he had found child abuse images at his father's home in the Philippines and reported it to the police.

The Philippines Department of Justice told the BBC that "the matter is currently being investigated" by an anti-human trafficking and child sexual exploitation task force.   The country’s interior minister told the BBC that national police had secured Thomas Markle’s computer to conduct a comprehensive digital forensic examination.

Harry and Meghan and their two children returned to the UK in August after six years in the US.  

Clive Myrie presents BBC News at Ten reporting by Johnny Diamond.

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

梅根·马克尔（ Meghan Markle ）说，她被告知2018年有关她疏远的父亲托马斯·马克尔（ Thomas Markle ）的“令人不安

菲律宾当局正在就有关虐待儿童图像的指控对他进行调查。

梅根在一份声明中表示，一封包含对托马斯·马克尔指控的信件已于当年发送给英国警方，并随后与她分享。

她形容这些指控“比人们所能想象的更令人作呕” ，并说她“最真诚的希望是正义将得到充分的伸张，优先考虑仍然是无辜儿童的安全和保护”。

她的评论是在有报道称在她父亲在菲律宾的前家中发现了据称属于她父亲的儿童性虐待图像之后发表的。

现年82岁、居住在美国的托马斯·马克尔（ Thomas Markle ）否认拥有任何此类图像，并将这些说法描述为“生病的谎言”。

梅根·马克尔（ Meghan Markle ）说： “我对过去24小时内曝光的消息深感悲痛，我的想法是与任何可能受到伤害的孩子在一起。”

她说，当她收到概述对她父亲指控的信时，她“得到了正在调查这些指控的保证”。

她补充说，她希望能够理解为什么她与父亲保持距离，并且“不允许他与我们的孩子接触”。

梅根说，这是“为了保护他们” ，并补充说她“相信当局正在为其他家庭做同样的事情”。

梅根的同父异母兄弟托马斯·马克尔（ Thomas Markle junior ）告诉太阳报，他在他父亲在菲律宾的家中发现了虐待儿童的照片，并向警方报案。

菲律宾司法部告诉英国广播公司，反人口贩运和儿童性剥削工作组“目前正在调查此事”。

该国内政部长告诉英国广播公司，国家警察已确保托马斯·马克尔的电脑进行全面的数字取证检查。

articles.summary:
US First Lady Melania Trump has "successfully secured" a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, the White House has said.

articles.readingText:
US First Lady Melania Trump has "successfully secured" a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, the White House has said.

It said the truce in the "front-line war city on the brink of disaster" without medicine, food and clean water would begin on 29 October.

Ukraine and Russia confirmed the deal was agreed to evacuate residents and deliver aid.

Moscow said its forces would stop firing at 04:00 (02:00 GMT) on 27 October.

The statement did not say how long the ceasefire would be in place for.

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news
articles.readingTextZh:
白宫表示，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普（ Melania Trump ）在俄罗斯占领的奥列什基（ Oleshky ）市“成功确保”了俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的停火。

它说，没有药品，食物和清洁水的“处于灾难边缘的前线战争城市”的休战将于10月29日开始。

乌克兰和俄罗斯证实，双方同意撤离居民并提供援助。

莫斯科表示，其部队将于10月27日04:00 （格林尼治标准时间02:00 ）停止射击。

声明没有说明停火将持续多久。
